hbb_position_block.interpretation_limit: Descriptive conditional resampling of frozen OOF losses, not guaranteed population coverage, simultaneous intervals, model-selection uncertainty or independent-study replication.
hbb_position_block.quantile_method: Type7 linear interpolation on sorted values, q=0.025 and0.975
hbb_position_block.unit_kind: Physical position blocks; all included positions in each sampled block

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional descriptive resampling of frozen OOF losses; no refitting, no guarantee of population coverage, shared studies and overlapping OOF training fits remain

primary_element.interpretation_limit: Descriptive conditional resampling of frozen OOF losses, not guaranteed population coverage, simultaneous intervals, model-selection uncertainty or independent-study replication.
primary_element.quantile_method: Type7 linear interpolation on sorted values, q=0.025 and0.975
primary_element.unit_kind: Primary promoter elements; each selected element has equal weight

bootstrap.relative_mse_definition: Per-assay model MSE divided by that assay's training-mean-baseline MSE; null when denominator is zero

adjusted_tails.interpretation_limit: Arithmetic multiplicity controls over six planned spatial-null tails; the artificial rotation distribution is not established as calibrated biological inference.

spatial_null.factorization_cache: Training X means/scales and Gram Cholesky reused because X is fixed; every rotated training ymean and RHS is recomputed
spatial_null.interpretation: Artificial chemistry-stratified spatial rotation diagnostic; does not preserve cross-class/within-position score correlations, absolute gaps or all library dependence. Not a calibrated biological-significance p-value; no threshold-based discovery claim.
spatial_null.transformation: One SplitMix64 stream over replicate then fullURNlex and directed-mutation order; each destination receives source(i+nonzerooffset)%stratumsize; size<2 unchanged without RNG draw
